title: add CI artifact signing, sbom generation, provenance and release manifests for private-installer
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Motivation: private-installer releases need reproducible artifacts, signed integrity checks, and machine-readable release manifests for air-gapped and VPC customers. This PR adds CI steps and helper scripts to: 1) produce structured release manifests for each installer build (yaml+json), 2) generate SBOMs via syft for all installer artifacts, 3) sign release artifacts and manifests with cosign (CI-backed keyless flow + optional KMS signing), 4) produce in-repo provenance metadata for audit and for downstream automated install/upgrade tooling, and 5) surface signed bundles to the release pipeline used by ops to publish release bundles. Changes include updates to the GitHub Actions workflows, new Makefile targets and small helper scripts, Helm chart package metadata updates, Terraform module pin bump for registry access, and an integration test that validates upgrade/rollback metadata. Checklist: - [x] Add syft SBOM generation job and SBOM upload step - [x] Add cosign signing and verify step (keyless + KMS toggle) - [x] Emit release-manifests JSON/YAML with SHA256, image digests and SBOM links - [x] Add provenance file (build info, commit, builder tool versions) - [x] Update helm charts package metadata (appVersion, provenance link) - [x] Bump terraform modules that reference registry artifacts - [x] Add integration test for upgrade/rollback manifest application - [x] Add docs/notes for release engineering runbook Non-goals: not changing installer runtime behavior or the operator; this is purely release and CI automation. Notes on security: cosign keyless flow is used by default in public CI. For customers requiring KMS-signed artifacts we added an optional CI secret path (RELEASE_SIGNER_KMS) and documented the operator steps in RELEASES.md. The experimenal provenance schema is compatible with existing release tooling and includes a manifestVer and buildToolVersion fields to aid future verification. See related Linear stories ENG-4321 (release automation) and ENG-4378 (provenance schema).
